root_cause.text: The RedBoot partition table parser in `drivers/mtd/parsers/redboot.c` uses `memcmp()` with fixed comparison lengths to check partition names, which causes an out-of-bounds read when the dynamically allocated `names` buffer is shorter than the specified comparison length.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff replaces `memcmp(names, "RedBoot config", 15)` and `memcmp(names, "FIS directory", 14)` with `strcmp()`, resolving a fortify warning where `memcmp` attempted a "15 byte read of buffer size 14".
